response.sql:
WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
), reference_averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg
    FROM equipment_averages
), kept AS (
    SELECT ea.equipref,
           ea.avg_humidity,
           ea.avg_humidity - ra.all_equipment_avg AS excess_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages ea
    CROSS JOIN reference_averages ra
    WHERE ra.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
      AND ea.avg_humidity > ra.all_equipment_avg
), with_kept_mean AS (
    SELECT k.*,
           AVG(avg_humidity) OVER () AS kept_avg
    FROM kept k
)
SELECT equipref,
       avg_humidity,
       excess_humidity,
       avg_humidity - kept_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM with_kept_mean
WHERE kept_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST, equipref
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Average of all equipment averages” means the unweighted mean of per-equipment averages; equipment with no non-missing humidity readings has no average and is excluded. The kept-only difference is signed (equipment average minus the kept-equipment mean).
